messages:
Marta: Morning — quick check: vendor signaled a supply window for ~50 standby H100 slots in us-west1 for the next 72h. Is that visible in quota/allocs? Need to confirm before we commit to the demo pool.
Sanjay: Not seeing it in our alloc API yet. Got the vendor email (ETA 48h). I’ll ping vendor ops for the canonical signal.
ProcurementBot: Vendor 'CoreCloud' update: PO#88912 currently PENDING, expected fulfillment 2026-03-23T14:00Z.
Kevin: Heads-up — we have 12 warm H100s in the standby pool in us-west2 that we could borrow short-term, not yet tied to demo.
Lina: @Sanjay can escalate to the rep if needed. Did vendor mention firmware image? We block on firmware parity for runtime.
Sanjay: Vendor said default firmware v2.1 on arrival; our bootstrap expects v2.3. They offered flash-to-2.3 but need a 6h maintenance window.
Kevin: I can run a quick smoke with v2.1 tonight. Command I'll use:
```
./smoke-test.sh --region us-west1 --image h100-v2.1-smoke
```
That should catch any kernel/QoS issues.
Marta: If smoke passes we can accept standby and schedule a fast firmware bake. Also need to confirm the quota bump in GCP console/alloc service — should show +50 GPUs in us-west1.
Oncall: Note — if we accept standby, remember to update autoscaler floor so we don't overprovision. I'll handle the change once we confirm.
ProcurementBot: PO#88912 status changed to IN_TRANSIT by vendor at 2026-03-20T21:10Z.
Sanjay: Vendor ops replied: can flash to 2.3 at arrival but requires a 6h window; asked if they can shorten. Also flagged that invoicing may be delayed ~24h.
Lina: Could we patch the runtime to tolerate v2.1 for warmup? That may be faster than waiting on vendor flash.
Kevin: Runtime team says minor perf delta but safe. Opening PR to allow backward firmware acceptance for smoke. PR#3428.
Marta: Quick recap / action items:
- Sanjay: confirm ETA + maintenance window with vendor
- Kevin: run smoke tonight and link the PR logs
- Lina: escalate to account rep if needed
- Oncall: prepare autoscaler update once confirmed
I'll wait for smoke result before we finalize demo pool allocation. :thumbsup:
Sanjay: ETA confirmed: 2026-03-21T06:00Z arrival slot, 6h maintenance window. Vendor noted invoice will trail by ~24h.
Kevin: Smoke started 22:10 UTC — initial kernel hiccup on first run but passes subsequent runs. Logs look stable. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/3428
Marta: Great. Please add brief status notes to the PR (smoke output + vendor ETA). We'll merge once smoke is green and CI passes.
